name: Hail of Stone
body:
School conjuration (creation) [earth]; Level druid 1, magus 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Area 5-foot radius cylinder, 40 ft. high

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

You cause a rain of stones to come down in the area dealing 1d4 bludgeoning damage per caster level (maximum 5d4) to all creatures in the area. A successful Reflex save halves this damage.
